stories.title: Microsoft 365 Crawls Back to Life After a 24-Hour Outage
stories.take: Microsoft says a bad update — not a cyberattack — crashed its servers worldwide. 365 is crawling back after 24 hours, and the blast radius is drawing CrowdStrike comparisons.

stories.title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
stories.take: The agent-tooling startup is now valued at $3B and claims 7,000 LangSmith customers. Agent infrastructure is where the money is pooling.

stories.title: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China’s most powerful AI models — uh oh, Jensen!
stories.take: New research says China's most advanced AI models were trained on banned Nvidia chips. The export wall has a hole in it — landing in the middle of the Jensen Huang scandal.

stories.title: OpenAI board member worries an AI "takeover" of society could be months away
stories.take: An OpenAI board member traces a path from AI reward hacking to a societal takeover possibly months away. The alarm is coming from inside the boardroom.

stories.title: This young startup wants to power floating data centers with the ocean’s heat, and investors are already on board
stories.take: Startup Drogue wants data centers on floating vessels powered by ocean heat, with a prototype crunching bits at sea in under two years.

stories.title: Kalshi ditches Trump Jr. as advisor; CEO admitted "optics" weren't good
stories.take: Kalshi cut Trump Jr. loose as an advisor after his firm's big Polymarket investment; the CEO admitted the 'optics' weren't good. He'd held equity while the Trump administration helped Kalshi in court.

stories.title: ‘We’re not trying to be TwitchTok’: Twitch adds new short-form video feature
stories.take: Twitch is adding short-form video to help smaller creators get discovered — and insists it is not just copying TikTok. Discovery is the pitch; the format is familiar.

stories.title: Playfly’s CEO explains why leagues are looking to consolidate local sports rights
stories.take: Playfly's CEO says leagues want to consolidate local sports rights as the regional sports network model crumbles. Simpler bundles for fans, cleaner sales for leagues.

stories.title: Home Depot, ESPN Among 2026 Brand Hall of Fame Inductees
stories.take: Home Depot and ESPN join the 2026 Brand Hall of Fame, and Apple becomes the first brand ever inducted into the Creative Hall of Fame.

stories.title: How do you redesign a cult kids’ product? I asked Yoto’s new designers
stories.take: Yoto's designers explain how they redesigned a cult kids' product without alienating its vocal community: hold back on screens, protect the mission.

stories.title: Welch’s holiday microdrama embraces Y2K nostalgia as Gen Z become parents
stories.take: Welch's holiday microdrama 'Before the Toast' leans on Y2K nostalgia for Gen Z parents, with an Instacart integration built into the campaign.

stories.title: Brandweek 2026: Why Gopuff Would ‘Rather Be Debated Than Ignored’ ft. Tyler Stewart
stories.take: Gopuff's Tyler Stewart told Brandweek the delivery upstart would rather be debated than ignored — when you can't outspend the giants, provocation is the media plan.

stories.title: Sources: Murray wants trade from Pelicans; both sides working on resolution
stories.take: Dejounte Murray wants out of New Orleans, and Rich Paul and the Pelicans have started working on a resolution, per Shams. The Pels' season keeps sliding.

stories.title: Prosecutors: Text shows plan to bet unders on Rozier's teammate
stories.take: Prosecutors say a co-defendant texted a gambler about a wagering scheme with Terry Rozier centered on another Hornets player. The betting case keeps widening.

stories.title: How can Warriors survive Stephen Curry's absence? Yaxel Lendeborg has to step up, but that's not all
stories.take: With Curry out at least two weeks with an oblique tear, Golden State needs rookie Yaxel Lendeborg to step up — and more — to hold its hot start.

stories.title: NBA Rookie of the Year race: Three players at top, but don't count out AJ Dybantsa, Darryn Peterson just yet
stories.take: A clear top five has formed in the Rookie of the Year race, but don't count out AJ Dybantsa or Darryn Peterson yet. Caleb Wilson's injury reshuffled the board.

stories.title: 📈 Updated Power Rankings: The best newcomer on all 30 teams
stories.take: ESPN's updated Power Rankings name the best newcomer on all 30 teams — a quick map of which additions are actually moving their teams.

stories.title: Jake Bauers reportedly agrees to $58 million deal with Red Sox after helping lead Brewers to World Series
stories.take: Jake Bauers parlayed a career year — 26 homers, more than double his previous high, and a World Series run with Milwaukee — into 4 years and $58M with Boston.

stories.title: Could Tarik Skubal take a short-term, high-AAV contract? Breaking down pros and cons
stories.take: The market's top free agent could trade years for a record annual salary. CBS breaks down why a short, rich deal might suit both Skubal and a team like the Dodgers.

stories.title: MLB rumors: Rangers in mix for Sato, Dodgers seek infield help, Korean slugger could join free agent class
stories.take: Hot stove Friday: the Rangers are in on Japanese slugger Teruaki Sato, the Dodgers want infield help, and a Korean slugger could join the free-agent class.

stories.title: Cubs' Crow-Armstrong, Astros' Alvarez sweep votes as unanimous MVP winners
stories.take: Pete Crow-Armstrong and Yordan Alvarez were unanimous MVP picks — Alvarez after nearly winning the Triple Crown, Crow-Armstrong after a breakout that put him on an all-time trajectory.

stories.title: Nationals, OF Young agree on 4-year deal with '31 option
stories.take: The Nationals lock up outfielder Jacob Young for four years with a 2031 team option — a quiet keep-the-core move in a loud free-agent week.

stories.title: New Orleans boat crash: tanker collides with river cruise ship carrying more than 130 people – latest updates
stories.take: A tanker hit the river cruise ship American Heritage, carrying more than 130 people, on the Mississippi in New Orleans. The ship is taking on water, rescues are under way, and the Coast Guard has closed the river between mile markers 93 and 96.

stories.title: Trump-backed Maga firebrand Lauren Boebert defeated in Colorado congressional race
stories.take: Lauren Boebert lost her re-election bid to Democrat Eileen Laubacher by less than 1%, per AP — another seat gone in a rough midterm cycle for Trump-backed Republicans.

stories.title: US supreme court agrees to consider Trump’s ban on asylum at US-Mexico border
stories.take: The Supreme Court will hear Trump's asylum ban at the southern border. Lower courts found the executive order illegal; the ruling will define how far a president can close the asylum door alone.

stories.title: Mamdani and Trump agree to 90-day delay on new food assistance rules for corner stores
stories.take: NYC Mayor Mamdani cut a deal with Trump for a 90-day delay on new SNAP rules, giving bodegas and corner stores nationwide time to comply.

stories.title: Officials name victims of fatal Brooklyn building collapse as investigation widens
stories.take: Officials named the eight people killed in the Brooklyn building collapse — six men, a boy and a girl — as the search ended and the investigation widened. Eighteen were injured, one critically.

stories.title: Trump bought Nvidia stock as he helped chipmaker with change to export rule
stories.take: Trump bought up to $5M of Nvidia stock while his administration rescinded a Biden-era rule limiting chip exports to China. The Huang relationship now has a stock ledger attached.

stories.title: Across racial lines, Americans celebrate Scott Colom’s historic election: ‘The times they are a-changin’
stories.take: Mississippi's Scott Colom is the state's first Black senator since Reconstruction, and his win helped build a Democratic Senate majority of at least 55 — the party's biggest midterm gain since 1986.

stories.title: Massive fin whale dies after beaching in Santa Cruz
stories.take: A massive fin whale — the second-largest species on Earth — died after beaching at Cowell Beach in Santa Cruz, where it had shown signs of illness Thursday. Crews are working on removal.

stories.title: Rain, dangerous surf and snow could hit Southern California. Here's where and when storms are expected
stories.take: The storm that arrived Thursday night is the first of three rolling through Southern California, bringing rain, dangerous surf and mountain snow into the weekend.

stories.title: What’s the future of the death penalty in California after Newsom’s clemency?
stories.take: Newsom's death-row commutations emptied the row but left the death penalty on the books — CalMatters maps the contradictory status quo and what voters may decide next.

stories.title: Newsom’s power move bruised Dems. Now, they look forward to the Becerra era
stories.take: With Prop. 5 passed, Xavier Becerra is pledging to treat Capitol Democrats better than Newsom did. The honeymoon lasts until budget season tests it.

stories.title: What happens when real estate agents have split allegiances?
stories.take: A Sonoma County lawsuit alleges a major brokerage shunted buyers into dual-agency deals. CalMatters explains what happens when your agent also works for the seller.

stories.title: A quarter of California voters unsure they will respond to the next census, poll finds
stories.take: A Berkeley IGS poll finds a quarter of California voters unsure they'll answer the 2030 Census, with younger voters and voters of color citing privacy — an undercount would cost the state seats and money.

stories.title: Can Israel’s Opposition Unseat Netanyahu?
stories.take: The answer: yes, but only via a bad option — opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot has 48 of the 61 seats needed and about a month to build a coalition • Every path hurts: unity with Netanyahu (a campaign non-starter), concessions to ultra-Orthodox parties on draft exemptions, or the record 19-seat Arab parties as kingmakers — which partner Lieberman flatly refuses • If Eisenkot fails, Netanyahu gets his own shot, then new elections with Netanyahu as caretaker — 'the clock is Netanyahu's friend'

stories.title: Nvidia's Future, Trump's Ties to Huang, US Mediates Russia-Ukraine Talks
stories.take: Jensen Huang resigned over affairs, including a woman who may have been recruited by China; CFO Kress steps in as interim CEO of the firm holding 80–90% of the AI GPU market • Trump stayed publicly supportive and floated Tim Cook as successor; Sen. Tim Scott is summoning Huang and Lutnick to December hearings • Witkoff and Kushner's shuttle diplomacy: prisoner-swap momentum and a push to bring Europe into a Russia-Ukraine security framework, while Putin publicly rules out European peacekeepers

stories.title: Why a CEO's affair may have national security implications
stories.take: The answer: Huang's affair partner is suspected of spying for China, and Nvidia's AI chips are barred from China on national-security grounds — yet Huang had lobbied Trump, successfully, to let one chip be sold to some Chinese companies • Rubio reportedly warned Trump before Huang rode Air Force One to China, contradicting Trump's claim he didn't know; Nvidia opened an independent investigation and lawmakers in both parties want hearings • Also: the failed Hegseth impeachment push, where 11 Democrats missed the vote

stories.title: Schumer Has Competition
stories.take: Van Hollen is challenging Schumer for Senate leader — voters 'have not yet hired Democrats,' he argues, and trust can't be earned with old leadership; Schumer says he has the votes • Lutnick fights for his job in the Huang fallout ahead of Dec 3 Senate Banking testimony, even as Commerce advances chip-shipment restrictions for seven countries • Ramp data: AI spending growth slowed to single digits — a price war, not falling demand; the top 1% of firms drive 80% of OpenAI and Anthropic revenue

stories.title: What's really at stake in the Jensen Huang saga
stories.take: The answer: this is the beginning, not the end — at stake is whether up to 20% of Nvidia's chip revenue came from illegal China-linked sales via Megaspeed, whether the circular-financing house of cards holds, and whether the US enforces its export controls after a Rubio-overseen memo flagged Alice Huang as a spy and Lutnick stalled the Commerce probe • Huang owns only ~3% with no dual-class shares, so no Altman-style comeback; interim CEO Kress may be the long-term pick because Huang's real job was financial engineering • Also: every streamer now wants a vertical-video feed (Disney Plus's 'Verts'), the Ocarina of Time remake's huge opening days, and the DC Films shakeup after Gunn and Safran's early exit

stories.title: Anthropic’s IPO Is Said to Be About Six Times Oversubscribed
stories.take: Anthropic's IPO is about 6x oversubscribed on day four of the roadshow — range $70–78, pricing Nov 18 — strong for a ~$1 trillion deal and ahead of SpaceX's pace; mainland China and Hong Kong institutions are barred from ordering • Nvidia's legal exposure, mapped: export-control penalties up to 2x the transaction value (theoretical double-digit billions) plus shareholder class actions that require proving knowing deception • Cisco is a growth company again — guidance raised ~$2.5B, AI outlook up to $9B, only 9% of customers on new gear in a $100B refresh cycle • BI analysts see no industrial logic in a reported SpaceX–Tesla merger

stories.title: Here’s What It Will Really Take To Fix America’s Economy — ft. Kathryn Anne Edwards
stories.take: Edwards' answer: stop producing inequality instead of taxing it afterward — invest in children and give workers power, as small wins every year over ~10 years • The specifics: cut the estate-tax exemption to $1M to fund a children's trust, sectoral bargaining and a higher minimum wage, end step-up basis and the mortgage deduction to fund below-market housing, lift the Social Security payroll cap • On the midterms: a 'blue nami' referendum on affordability and corruption — 'They can't afford their life. That is the assignment.'

stories.title: Hasan Piker Has Joined the Party
stories.take: Klein tests whether the left can hold the coalition: Piker argues 'vulgar Bernieism' won the war — every Democrat ran economics-first against billionaires, data centers and AI, while the party grew both its DSA left and its Blue Dog moderates • Piker's program: Medicare for All stays the North Star even if built in pieces, culture-war fights are distractions to refuse, and Chinese EVs stay tariffed to protect domestic manufacturing • The fault line is Israel: Klein presses Piker's Nazi and KKK comparisons and Piker doesn't climb down — he calls Oct 7 war crimes he never condoned, but argues the occupation made an explosion inevitable

stories.title: Cybertruck Ending Production Next Year!
stories.take: Tesla winds down Cybertruck production mid-next-year at Gigafactory Texas to make room for Cybercab — total sales of only ~70–73k against a 500k-a-year ambition, and nothing under $90k versus the promised $35k fleet truck • Hands-on with Google's Gemini smart glasses (Warby Parker from $395, out Dec 10): live translation at roughly a half-second delay was the standout, but face-camera privacy questions remain • Adobe MAX's 'redemption arc': a creative agent that does multi-step busywork with the apps' real tools, plus MCP support • Ring Robotics is Amazon's Astro repurposed as a $1,000 patrol bot, alongside a $250 indoor drone with an 8-minute flight time
